# Paths trufflehog skips (--exclude-paths, one regex per line). The scan runs
# with --results=verified,unknown (IMPL-0020 Open Question 4), so a
# credential-shaped string it cannot verify fails the job. Each entry below
# is a placeholder DSN, never a real credential, with the reason beside it.
# The DSNs are described rather than quoted: quoting them here is itself a
# finding.
#
